title: Codex CI configuration
description: Key workflows and follow-up CI recommendations for Codex CI triage, read from .github/giskard/codex-ci-config.json.

$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema reference for editor support.

key_workflows.description: Workflow names that must have a terminal, successful run on the pull request head SHA.

recommendations.description: Rules that recommend extra CI when matching paths changed and the named workflow has not run.

target.description: Workflow name or label the action applies to.

reason.description: Explanation shown in the triage output. Defaults to "<action> <target>".

when.description: Built-in matcher. package_related matches manifest and lockfile changes; when set, path matchers are ignored.

when_paths.description: Exact changed paths that trigger the rule.

when_path_prefixes.description: Changed path prefixes that trigger the rule.

when_path_prefixes_also.description: Additional path prefixes, evaluated like when_path_prefixes.

missing_workflow.description: Skip the rule when a workflow with this name already ran for the head SHA.

missing_any_workflows.description: Skip the rule when any of these workflows already ran for the head SHA.
